description: PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for current stock / index / ETF / crypto / FX / commodity quotes by symbol, "what is Apple stock at", "Nasdaq 100 level right now", "S&P 500 today", "AAPL price", "how is the Dow doing vs the Nasdaq". Accepts one or more Yahoo Finance symbols (or ISINs, matched to the exchange listing; optional exchange picks one when an ISIN has several) and returns current price, previous close, change, daily % change, trading volume, day high/low, the quote timestamp (as_of) and market_state (open/pre/post/closed) so you can tell a live price from a stale close. Symbols: stocks AAPL/MSFT/TSLA and non-US listings by exchange suffix (EL.PA Euronext Paris, FME.DE Xetra, 7203.T Tokyo, 0700.HK Hong Kong, HSBA.L London); indices ^GSPC (S&P 500), ^NDX (Nasdaq 100), ^IXIC (Nasdaq Composite), ^DJI (Dow), ^RUT (Russell 2000), ^FTSE, ^N225 (Nikkei); crypto BTC-USD/ETH-USD; FX EURUSD=X; commodities CL=F (crude), GC=F (gold). Keyless (Yahoo Finance). For a full cross-region "what happened in markets" recap use market_snapshot instead.

exchange.description: Only used when a symbol is an ISIN that trades on several exchanges: a suffix such as ".DE" / ".PA" or an exchange name such as "Xetra" picks the listing. Without it an ISIN with several listings returns the candidates instead of a price.

symbols.description: One or more Yahoo Finance symbols, e.g. "AAPL" or ["^NDX","^DJI","AAPL"]. A comma-separated string is also accepted.

name: get_quotes

outputSchema.description: Latest quotes for one or more symbols. `symbols` accepts a string or an array; an unresolved symbol still returns a row with found:false.

as_of.description: ISO time of the last trade the price reflects

candidates.description: Listings to choose from when an ISIN has several (or the hint matched none)

empty_reason.description: Why an ISIN produced no price

resolution_note.description: Which listing the ISIN was matched to and why

resolved_from_isin.description: Present when the symbol asked for was an ISIN: the ISIN as given

title: Get Quotes
